function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the user's full question using only evidence, entities, relationships, and source IDs returned by the benchmark tools. Produce a structured evidence dossier for a later report, not invented citations. Cover three linked areas: (1) how public sources describe Conti as a ransomware-as-a-service operation, including its operating model and any stated caveats; (2) what Conti-related leaks, especially primary or contemporaneous materials, reveal about internal organization, roles, workflows, recruitment, negotiation, payments, affiliates, administrators, developers, and relationships—only where the sources support those conclusions; and (3) how official law-enforcement or court records connect specific aliases and defendants to Conti activity. For every item, label it as documented fact, allegation, government assessment, source-reported claim, inference, or unresolved uncertainty. Prioritize official records and primary/contemporaneous leak materials. Preserve exact benchmark source IDs and entity IDs/names as returned; do not create unsupported IDs, relationship names, aliases, chronology, or identity mappings. Note conflicts between sources and distinguish an accusation or attribution from an adjudicated finding. Return enough detail to support a complete readable Markdown report and a final fenced JSON object with exactly arrays named findings, claims, reasoning_steps, and contradictions; specify the required fields for each array item: findings question/answer/supporting_entities/source_references; claims claim/source_references; reasoning_steps id/conclusion/premise_entities/premise_relations; contradictions contradiction_id/description/source_references."}
function.name: ConductResearch
